notes.subject: Héa
notes.rationale: האח em i singaut bilong wokabaut bilong ol birua (aha!); Tok Pisin i no gat wankain singaut, mi holim nois bilong en

notes.subject: bel bilong mipela i laim
notes.rationale: נפשנו (nafesh bilong mipela) — em i laik/traipela tingting bilong laik, no 'soul'

notes.subject: בלענוהו
notes.rationale: בלע = olsem swerim/kaikaiim olgeta — piksa bilong snek o waitpela kaikai; Tok Pisin 'kaikaiim em olgeta'

translation: Ol i no ken tok long bel bilong ol: Héa, bilong olgeta samting mipela i laim! Ol i no ken tok: Mipela i kaikaiim em olgeta.

tokens.gloss: bilong olgeta samting mipela i laim
